purpose: Third unseen challenge suite; introduces reusable core-vs-WIC classification, field ambiguity, transient/measurement validity, and multi-fault cases. Expected answers defined before frozen Brain run.

cases.title: High SH but measurement taken before stable operation

expected.system_check_result: High superheat is not yet valid for steady-state diagnosis
confirmed_findings: High evaporator superheat is recorded without confirmed stable cooling
expected.what_this_means: Transient operation can make superheat misleading.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm stable cooling, allow stabilization, then repeat superheat and liquid-side checks.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from this reading alone.

expected.next_action_check: Use the equipment charging method and applicable measurement location before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from an inapplicable subcooling target.

expected.system_check_result: LP control setting/fault may stop cooling prematurely
expected.what_this_means: If the control opens above the intended cutout, the room can warm even though refrigeration hardware is otherwise capable.
expected.next_action_check: Verify actual suction pressure and LP cutout/cut-in against the equipment sequence; adjust/repair as required.

expected.system_check_result: Direct condenser fan fault should be acted on even when operating state is not fully characterized

expected.what_this_means: A direct physical fault is actionable and should not be hidden behind a generic request for state.
